Claire Ng: Heads-up  several EU trial signups showing "indexing" stuck and delayed activation emails. I exported 64 affected tenants. Need a short customer note + standardized credit and AE flagging.

Diego Martin: Infra snapshot: brief downstream 502 spike caused retry amplification; two indexer JVM pauses created consumer lag. Applied retry cap and scaled consumers at 3490022000. Drain ETA ~30-45m.

Marta Vasquez: Draft customer copy (concise):

Marta Vasquez: "Hello  we're sorry for the interruption. Some EU trials may experience slower activations and partial search results while we clear an indexing backlog. Engineers have applied mitigations and we expect recovery within 1 hour.

Impacted trials will receive a $200 credit automatically. If you need prioritized help, book a 1:1: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We'll follow up with a full RCA.  Redwood Support"

Claire Ng: Agree on $200 for trials <6 months. Manual backfills for high-touch only. I'll DM AEs with any accounts >$12k ARR.

DeployBot: Roll/retry-cap-214 applied  success @ 3490022222

Diego Martin: Queue drain progress: 45% @12m, 90% @32m. No data loss. GC tuning scheduled in postmortem.

Marta Vasquez: Sending first wave to affected trials now (email + in-app). Subject: "Update: temporary activation delays for some EU trials". Includes credit note and booking link.

CS Bot: Incident INC-7210 logged  affected=64  status=mitigated  office hours attached.

Claire Ng: Timeline: 1) customer note (sent) 2) status page update when drain = 100% 3) RCA + renewal-risk comms within 24h 4) credits issued + short survey within 48h. I'll coordinate AE outreach. Thanks all. :pray:
